promptEs: Escuchá el dictado en 4/4. ¿Qué secuencia de figuras produce la síncopa?
explanationEs: La síncopa aparece porque las negras empiezan en la parte débil de cada pulso y se prolongan sobre el pulso siguiente. La secuencia suma cuatro tiempos.
promptEn: Listen to the dictation in 4/4. Which sequence of note values produces the syncopation?
explanationEn: The syncopation appears because the quarter notes start on the weak part of each beat and extend over the next beat. The sequence adds up to four beats.
choicesEn: Eighth note, Quarter note, Quarter note, Quarter note, Eighth note
Quarter note, Quarter note, Quarter note, Quarter note
Eighth note, Eighth note, Quarter note, Quarter note, Eighth note
Quarter note, Eighth note, Quarter note, Eighth note, Quarter note
